analysis.title: USD Rates Chart Pack: Futures Positions & Curve Analysis
key_insights: Chart pack from CACIB US Rates Strategy (Alex Li), dated 16/11/2026. It covers CFTC Commitment of Traders positioning in Treasury, SOFR, Fed funds and equity index futures, plus swap and Treasury curve spreads and butterflies. The report states that extreme positioning and curvature may lead to rate or curve changes near term.

Non-commercial net positioning in Treasury futures is short across every contract shown: TU -1,002.5K, FV -1,275.4K, TY -962.4K, UXY -136.4K, WN -361.9K, US -9.1K. The 5Y (FV) is the largest net short and the Bond (US) is nearly flat.
Non-commercial net positioning in STIR futures is mixed. 3M SOFR is -2,683.8K, 1M SOFR is +101.4K and 30-day Fed funds is +29.2K.
Non-commercial net positioning in equity index futures is split. E-Mini S&P 500 is -129.4K and the Nasdaq 100 mini is +42.9K.
The Treasury curve flattened between 11/9 and 11/13/2026. 2s30s fell from 70.7 to 61.4, 2s10s from 31.4 to 28.1 and 5s30s from 59.2 to 50.5. 2s5s was 10.9 on 11/13 versus 11.4 on 11/9.

The swap curve is much flatter than the Treasury curve. On 11/13/2026 swap 2s30s was 11.6 versus 61.4 for Treasuries, and swap 2s5s was -3.2 (inverted) versus +10.9 for Treasuries. Swap 2s30s fell from 18.8 on 11/9.

Swap curve history in the chart pack since 2020: 2s30s ranged from -194.50 to 180.33 (average 8.15). Treasury 2s30s since 2000 ranged from -116.89 to 257.09 (average 90.36). Current Treasury 2s30s of 61.4 is below its long-run average, while swap 2s30s of 11.6 is close to its 2020-onward average.

Butterfly levels on 11/13/2026: swap 2-5-10 was -4.6, 2-10-30 was -2.3, 5-7-10 was -2.7, 5-10-30 was -1.0 and 10-20-30 was 11.7. Treasury 2-5-10 was -3.1, 2-10-30 was -2.6, 5-7-10 was -1.2, 5-10-30 was -8.1 and 10-20-30 was 21.2. The report's rule is that a high long-the-belly spread means the belly is cheap versus the wings.

The pack also includes SOFR futures open interest (1M and 3M), 10-year US-Japan and US-Germany yield spreads, and Fed SOMA holdings of Treasuries and MBS. The extracted text carries no figures or commentary for these charts.
